say: You've had a few drinks, so you do the *sensible* thing. You sleep it off in your car.
Engine off. You're not driving. But you could still get *ten* *points* on your licence.
Because the law says you're *in* *charge* of the car. You're in it, with the keys, and over the limit.
It's called *drunk* *in* *charge.* Ten penalty points, or a ban. And up to *three* *months* in prison.
Even asleep, with the engine off, you *can* be charged.
The Highway Code warns you may still be *unfit* to drive the *morning* *after* drinking.
So after a night out, leave the car. Get a *taxi* or a lift, and collect it when you're sure you're fit to drive.
Quick quiz. Asleep in your parked car, over the limit, keys with you. Can you get points? *A* or *B?*
It's *B.* You can get ten points. Follow for more.
